items.name: Connect
items.description: Connects compatible subscription providers and clients for device authorization, managed subscription synchronization, and read-only provider messages.

release_feed.name: Connect 0.0.1
release_feed.body: Initial signed foundation release for the ZBoard and ZNet Sink package hosts. Package verification and installation surfaces are available; account authorization, subscription delivery, and provider messages remain disabled until the required host APIs land.

release_feed.name: Connect 0.0.1-dev.202609150807
release_feed.body: Signed development foundation for the ZBoard and ZNet Sink package hosts. This release validates automated distribution and installation wiring; account authorization, subscription synchronization, and provider messages are not enabled yet.

items.name: OAuth for ZBoard
items.description: Sign in to ZBoard with GitHub, Google or a custom OAuth2 / OpenID Connect provider.

release_feed.name: v0.0.2-dev.202609140217
release_feed.body:
OAuth for ZBoard v0.0.2-dev.202609140217

Sign in with GitHub, Google or a custom OAuth2 / OpenID Connect provider. ZBoard owns account creation, registration policy and sessions.

Download the signed `.zbplugin` for your host platform. Verify its SHA-256 against `SHA256SUMS` and obtain the publisher public key through a trusted channel before offline import.

Source: `57686460beb2a828377c1cf02a3810a8e1d7ab5e`. See the repository configuration and installation guides. `marketplace-entry.json` is a submission record, not a host catalog or a trust grant. Cross-compilation does not establish target-platform or live-provider acceptance.
